comparison.objective: Uniformly heat-shrink a sleeve over a cable lug.
comparison.physical_skill: Rotate a cable while sweeping a heat gun to control spatial and temporal heat dose.
comparison.success_condition: All sleeve stations recovered, ends sealed, none charred, gun safely off and returned, hands clear.
comparison.reason: Although it uses bimanual repetitive motion and process coverage, it has no apertured tool or selective material passage.
